options.content: Every item that needs attention, with no limit on age or on the number of rows, using the same rules and severities as the Needs attention tab of [Engineering Delivery & AI Usage](/d/engineering_delivery_ai_usage?${project:queryparam}). That tab leaves out items with no activity in the last 90 days and shows only the top 100; this list does neither. Last activity is the latest comment, commit or update on the item, or the finish time of a failed deploy.

WITH
project_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
project_boards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS board_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
project_cicd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS scope_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
scoped_cicd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS scope_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
prod_deploys AS (
  SELECT dc.cicd_scope_id AS scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment) AS env, dc.cicd_deployment_id AS id,
    MIN(dc.repo_id) AS repo_id, MIN(dc.finished_date) AS ts, MIN(dc.commit_sha) AS sha, MIN(dc.url) AS url, MAX(dc.result IN ('FAILURE', 'FAILED')) AS failed
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
    AND dc.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'FAILED') AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%'
    AND dc.finished_date < NOW()
  GROUP BY dc.cicd_scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment), dc.cicd_deployment_id
),
issue_base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pb.project_name, pb.board_id, i.id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.url, i.priority, i.type, i.status, i.original_status,
    i.assignee_id, i.assignee_name, i.created_date, i.id LIKE 'jira:%' AS is_jira,
    COALESCE(i.updated_date, i.created_date) AS last_activity, i.updated_date
  FROM project_boards pb
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.board_id = pb.board_id
  JOIN issues i ON i.id = bi.issue_id
  WHERE i.status <> 'DONE' AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
    AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Closed', 'Cancelled', 'Invalid')
    
),
status_now AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MAX(h.start_date) AS since
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.is_current_status = 1 AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM issue_base)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
first_progress AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MIN(h.start_date) AS started
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM issue_base)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
open_issues AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ib.project_name, ib.board_id, ib.id, ib.issue_key, ib.title, ib.url, ib.priority, ib.type, ib.status, ib.original_status,
    ib.assignee_id, ib.assignee_name, ib.created_date, ib.is_jira, ib.last_activity,
    COALESCE(sn.since, ib.updated_date, ib.created_date) AS status_since
  FROM issue_base ib
  LEFT JOIN status_now sn ON sn.issue_id = ib.id
)
, merged_90 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr.id, pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date) AS merge_min
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM project_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND pr.merged_date < NOW()
),
repo_med AS (
  SELECT repo_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'merge' AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN v END) AS merge_median,
    MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'pickup' AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN v END) AS pickup_median
  FROM (
    SELECT repo_id, kind, v,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id, kind ORDER BY v) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id, kind) AS n
    FROM (
      SELECT repo_id, 'merge' AS kind, merge_min AS v FROM merged_90
      UNION ALL
      SELECT m.repo_id, 'pickup', MIN(ppm.pr_pickup_time)
      FROM merged_90 m
      JOIN project_pr_metrics ppm ON ppm.id = m.id
      WHERE ppm.pr_pickup_time IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY m.id, m.repo_id
    ) vals
  ) ranked
  GROUP BY repo_id
),
open_prs_all AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr.id, pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, pp.project_name, CONCAT('#', pr.pull_request_key) AS item, pr.title, pr.url,
    pr.created_date, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, NOW()) AS age_min,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name, ''), NULLIF(a.user_name, ''), pr.author_name) AS owner
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_repos pp ON pp.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
  WHERE pr.status = 'OPEN' AND COALESCE(pr.is_draft, 0) = 0 AND pr.created_date < NOW()
),
pr_comment_last AS (
  SELECT c.pull_request_id, MAX(c.created_date) AS last_at
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  WHERE c.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM open_prs_all)
  GROUP BY c.pull_request_id
),
pr_commit_last AS (
  SELECT prc.pull_request_id, MAX(prc.commit_authored_date) AS last_at
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  WHERE prc.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM open_prs_all)
  GROUP BY prc.pull_request_id
),
open_prs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x.id, x.repo_id, x.project_name, x.item, x.title, x.url, x.created_date, x.age_min, x.owner, x.last_activity
  FROM (
    SELECT op.id, op.repo_id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.created_date, op.age_min, op.owner,
      GREATEST(op.created_date, COALESCE(cl.last_at, op.created_date), COALESCE(kl.last_at, op.created_date)) AS last_activity
    FROM open_prs_all op
    LEFT JOIN pr_comment_last cl ON cl.pull_request_id = op.id
    LEFT JOIN pr_commit_last kl ON kl.pull_request_id = op.id
  ) x
  WHERE x.age_min >= 0 
),
stale_prs AS (
  SELECT op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.owner, op.age_min, op.last_activity
  FROM open_prs op
  LEFT JOIN repo_med rm ON rm.repo_id = op.repo_id
  WHERE op.age_min > COALESCE(2 * rm.merge_median, 14 * 1440)
),
waiting_reviews AS (
  SELECT op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.age_min, op.last_activity,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(prr.name, ''), prr.user_name) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(prr.name, ''), prr.user_name) SEPARATOR ', ') AS reviewers
  FROM open_prs op
  JOIN pull_request_reviewers prr ON prr.pull_request_id = op.id
  WHERE op.age_min > 2 * 1440
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments c
      WHERE c.pull_request_id = op.id AND c.account_id = prr.reviewer_id AND c.type IN ('REVIEW', 'DIFF'))
  GROUP BY op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.age_min, op.last_activity
),
resolved_90 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.id, bi.board_id, i.resolution_date
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (SELECT board_id FROM project_boards)
    AND i.resolution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND i.resolution_date < NOW()
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC' AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid')
),
resolved_start AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MIN(h.start_date) AS started
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM resolved_90)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
board_med AS (
  SELECT board_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN days END) AS median_days
  FROM (
    SELECT r.board_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rs.started, r.resolution_date) / 1440 AS days,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.board_id ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rs.started, r.resolution_date)) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.board_id) AS n
    FROM resolved_90 r
    JOIN resolved_start rs ON rs.issue_id = r.id
  ) ranked
  GROUP BY board_id
),
stalled AS (
  SELECT oi.project_name, oi.id, oi.issue_key, oi.title, oi.url, oi.assignee_name, oi.last_activity,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, COALESCE(fp.started, oi.status_since), NOW()) / 24 AS days_in_progress,
    COALESCE(2 * bm.median_days, 14) AS threshold_days
  FROM open_issues oi
  LEFT JOIN first_progress fp ON fp.issue_id = oi.id
  LEFT JOIN board_med bm ON bm.board_id = oi.board_id
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND oi.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
    AND COALESCE(oi.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Closed', 'To Do', 'To do', 'Todo', 'Ready for Development')
    AND NOT oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
),
multi_sprint AS (
  SELECT si.issue_id, COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) AS sprints, MIN(s.started_date) AS first_start
  FROM sprint_issues si
  JOIN sprints s ON s.id = si.sprint_id
  GROUP BY si.issue_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) >= 2
),
scope_added AS (
  SELECT ic.issue_id, MAX(ic.created_date) AS added_at
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM open_issues WHERE is_jira) oj
  JOIN issue_changelogs ic ON ic.issue_id = oj.id AND ic.field_name = 'Sprint'
  JOIN sprints s ON s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND FIND_IN_SET(s.id, ic.original_to_value) AND NOT FIND_IN_SET(s.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
  WHERE ic.created_date > s.started_date AND (s.completed_date IS NULL OR ic.created_date < s.completed_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM sprints p
      WHERE FIND_IN_SET(p.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
        AND p.completed_date BETWEEN ic.created_date - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND ic.created_date + INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
  GROUP BY ic.issue_id
),
latest_deploy AS (
  SELECT scope_id, env, sha, url, ts, failed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scope_id, env ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn
  FROM prod_deploys
),
att_raw AS (
  SELECT 'High' AS severity, 2 AS severity_rank, 'Unapproved PR' AS category, 2 AS cat_rank, op.item, op.title,
    CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440), 'd, no approving review') AS reason, FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440) AS age_days,
    op.project_name, op.owner, op.url, CONCAT('pr:', op.id) AS ref, op.last_activity
  FROM open_prs op
  LEFT JOIN repo_med rm ON rm.repo_id = op.repo_id
  WHERE op.age_min > COALESCE(rm.pickup_median, 2 * 1440)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments c WHERE c.pull_request_id = op.id AND c.status = 'APPROVED')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 'Low' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 4 ELSE 2 END,
    'Stale PR', 3, sp.item, sp.title,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      THEN CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, no activity for ', TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sp.last_activity, NOW()), 'd')
      ELSE CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, past twice the repo median to merge') END,
    FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), sp.project_name, sp.owner, sp.url, CONCAT('pr:', sp.id), sp.last_activity
  FROM stale_prs sp
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Medium' END, CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
    'Review waiting', 1, wr.item, wr.title, CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), 'd, requested reviewer has not reviewed'),
    FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), wr.project_name, wr.reviewers, wr.url, CONCAT('pr:', wr.id), wr.last_activity
  FROM waiting_reviews wr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
    'Blocked ticket', 4, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'High', 2, 'Stalled ticket', 5, st.issue_key, st.title,
    CONCAT('In progress ', FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), 'd, limit ', FLOOR(st.threshold_days), 'd'),
    FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), st.project_name, NULLIF(st.assignee_name, ''), st.url, CONCAT('issue:', st.id), st.last_activity
  FROM stalled st
  WHERE st.days_in_progress > st.threshold_days
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Not closing', 6, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('In ', ms.sprints, ' sprints without closing'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ms.first_start, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN multi_sprint ms ON ms.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 'Critical' WHEN 'High' THEN 'High' WHEN 'Medium' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END,
    CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 1 WHEN 'High' THEN 2 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
    'Open bug', 7, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(oi.priority, ''), 'Unprioritised'), ' bug open ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE (oi.type = 'BUG' OR (oi.id LIKE 'github:%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels il WHERE il.issue_id = oi.id AND il.label_name IN ('bug','Production-Bug'))))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Unassigned in Ready', 8, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd, no assignee'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULL, oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND (oi.original_status IN ('Selected for Development', 'Dev Ready', 'Ready for Dev', 'Ready for Development') OR (oi.original_status IN ('To do', 'To Do', 'Todo') AND oi.id IN (SELECT si_r.issue_id FROM sprint_issues si_r JOIN sprints sp_r ON sp_r.id = si_r.sprint_id WHERE sp_r.status = 'ACTIVE'))) AND COALESCE(oi.assignee_id, '') = ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Critical', 1, 'Failed deploy', 9, CONCAT(ld.env, ' · ', LEFT(ld.sha, 7)), CONCAT(cs.name, ' · ', ld.env),
    CONCAT('Latest prod deployment failed ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), 'd ago, no success since'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), pc.project_name, NULL, ld.url, CONCAT('deploy:', ld.scope_id, ':', ld.env), ld.ts
  FROM latest_deploy ld
  JOIN project_cicd pc ON pc.scope_id = ld.scope_id
  JOIN cicd_scopes cs ON cs.id = ld.scope_id
  WHERE ld.rn = 1 AND ld.failed = 1 
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Scope added', 10, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('Added to the active sprint ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), 'd ago'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN scope_added sa ON sa.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
),
attention AS (
  SELECT severity, severity_rank, category, item, title, reason, age_days, project_name, owner, url, last_activity
  FROM (
    SELECT ar.severity, ar.severity_rank, ar.category, ar.item, ar.title, ar.reason, ar.age_days, ar.project_name, ar.owner, ar.url, ar.last_activity,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.project_name, ar.ref ORDER BY ar.severity_rank, ar.cat_rank) AS pick
    FROM att_raw ar
    WHERE ar.category IN ($category)
  ) ranked_items
  WHERE pick = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS Items
FROM attention
WHERE severity IN ($severity)

open_issues AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ib.project_name, ib.board_id, ib.id, ib.issue_key, ib.title, ib.url, ib.priority, ib.type, ib.status, ib.original_status,
    ib.assignee_id, ib.assignee_name, ib.created_date, ib.is_jira, ib.last_activity,
    COALESCE(sn.since, ib.updated_date, ib.created_date) AS status_since
  FROM issue_base ib
  LEFT JOIN status_now sn ON sn.issue_id = ib.id
)
, merged_90 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr.id, pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date) AS merge_min
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM project_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND pr.merged_date < NOW()
),

  SELECT repo_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'merge' AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN v END) AS merge_median,
    MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'pickup' AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN v END) AS pickup_median
  FROM (
    SELECT repo_id, kind, v,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id, kind ORDER BY v) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id, kind) AS n
    FROM (

      FROM merged_90 m
      JOIN project_pr_metrics ppm ON ppm.id = m.id
      WHERE ppm.pr_pickup_time IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY m.id, m.repo_id
    ) vals
  ) ranked
  GROUP BY repo_id
),
open_prs_all AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr.id, pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, pp.project_name, CONCAT('#', pr.pull_request_key) AS item, pr.title, pr.url,
    pr.created_date, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, NOW()) AS age_min,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name, ''), NULLIF(a.user_name, ''), pr.author_name) AS owner
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_repos pp ON pp.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
  WHERE pr.status = 'OPEN' AND COALESCE(pr.is_draft, 0) = 0 AND pr.created_date < NOW()
),
pr_comment_last AS (
  SELECT c.pull_request_id, MAX(c.created_date) AS last_at
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  WHERE c.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM open_prs_all)
  GROUP BY c.pull_request_id
),
pr_commit_last AS (
  SELECT prc.pull_request_id, MAX(prc.commit_authored_date) AS last_at
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  WHERE prc.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM open_prs_all)
  GROUP BY prc.pull_request_id
),
open_prs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x.id, x.repo_id, x.project_name, x.item, x.title, x.url, x.created_date, x.age_min, x.owner, x.last_activity
  FROM (
    SELECT op.id, op.repo_id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.created_date, op.age_min, op.owner,
      GREATEST(op.created_date, COALESCE(cl.last_at, op.created_date), COALESCE(kl.last_at, op.created_date)) AS last_activity
    FROM open_prs_all op
    LEFT JOIN pr_comment_last cl ON cl.pull_request_id = op.id
    LEFT JOIN pr_commit_last kl ON kl.pull_request_id = op.id
  ) x
  WHERE x.age_min >= 0 
),
stale_prs AS (
  SELECT op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.owner, op.age_min, op.last_activity
  FROM open_prs op
  LEFT JOIN repo_med rm ON rm.repo_id = op.repo_id
  WHERE op.age_min > COALESCE(2 * rm.merge_median, 14 * 1440)
),
waiting_reviews AS (
  SELECT op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.age_min, op.last_activity,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(prr.name, ''), prr.user_name) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(prr.name, ''), prr.user_name) SEPARATOR ', ') AS reviewers
  FROM open_prs op
  JOIN pull_request_reviewers prr ON prr.pull_request_id = op.id
  WHERE op.age_min > 2 * 1440
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments c
      WHERE c.pull_request_id = op.id AND c.account_id = prr.reviewer_id AND c.type IN ('REVIEW', 'DIFF'))
  GROUP BY op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.age_min, op.last_activity
),
resolved_90 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.id, bi.board_id, i.resolution_date
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (SELECT board_id FROM project_boards)
    AND i.resolution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND i.resolution_date < NOW()
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC' AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid')
),
resolved_start AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MIN(h.start_date) AS started
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM resolved_90)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
board_med AS (
  SELECT board_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN days END) AS median_days
  FROM (
    SELECT r.board_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rs.started, r.resolution_date) / 1440 AS days,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.board_id ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rs.started, r.resolution_date)) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.board_id) AS n
    FROM resolved_90 r
    JOIN resolved_start rs ON rs.issue_id = r.id
  ) ranked
  GROUP BY board_id
),
stalled AS (
  SELECT oi.project_name, oi.id, oi.issue_key, oi.title, oi.url, oi.assignee_name, oi.last_activity,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, COALESCE(fp.started, oi.status_since), NOW()) / 24 AS days_in_progress,
    COALESCE(2 * bm.median_days, 14) AS threshold_days
  FROM open_issues oi
  LEFT JOIN first_progress fp ON fp.issue_id = oi.id
  LEFT JOIN board_med bm ON bm.board_id = oi.board_id
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND oi.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
    AND COALESCE(oi.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Closed', 'To Do', 'To do', 'Todo', 'Ready for Development')
    AND NOT oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
),
multi_sprint AS (
  SELECT si.issue_id, COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) AS sprints, MIN(s.started_date) AS first_start
  FROM sprint_issues si
  JOIN sprints s ON s.id = si.sprint_id
  GROUP BY si.issue_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) >= 2
),
scope_added AS (
  SELECT ic.issue_id, MAX(ic.created_date) AS added_at
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM open_issues WHERE is_jira) oj
  JOIN issue_changelogs ic ON ic.issue_id = oj.id AND ic.field_name = 'Sprint'
  JOIN sprints s ON s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND FIND_IN_SET(s.id, ic.original_to_value) AND NOT FIND_IN_SET(s.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
  WHERE ic.created_date > s.started_date AND (s.completed_date IS NULL OR ic.created_date < s.completed_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM sprints p
      WHERE FIND_IN_SET(p.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
        AND p.completed_date BETWEEN ic.created_date - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND ic.created_date + INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
  GROUP BY ic.issue_id
),
latest_deploy AS (
  SELECT scope_id, env, sha, url, ts, failed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scope_id, env ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn
  FROM prod_deploys
),
att_raw AS (
  SELECT 'High' AS severity, 2 AS severity_rank, 'Unapproved PR' AS category, 2 AS cat_rank, op.item, op.title,
    CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440), 'd, no approving review') AS reason, FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440) AS age_days,
    op.project_name, op.owner, op.url, CONCAT('pr:', op.id) AS ref, op.last_activity
  FROM open_prs op
  LEFT JOIN repo_med rm ON rm.repo_id = op.repo_id
  WHERE op.age_min > COALESCE(rm.pickup_median, 2 * 1440)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments c WHERE c.pull_request_id = op.id AND c.status = 'APPROVED')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 'Low' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 4 ELSE 2 END,
    'Stale PR', 3, sp.item, sp.title,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      THEN CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, no activity for ', TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sp.last_activity, NOW()), 'd')
      ELSE CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, past twice the repo median to merge') END,
    FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), sp.project_name, sp.owner, sp.url, CONCAT('pr:', sp.id), sp.last_activity
  FROM stale_prs sp
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Medium' END, CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
    'Review waiting', 1, wr.item, wr.title, CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), 'd, requested reviewer has not reviewed'),
    FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), wr.project_name, wr.reviewers, wr.url, CONCAT('pr:', wr.id), wr.last_activity
  FROM waiting_reviews wr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
    'Blocked ticket', 4, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'High', 2, 'Stalled ticket', 5, st.issue_key, st.title,
    CONCAT('In progress ', FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), 'd, limit ', FLOOR(st.threshold_days), 'd'),
    FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), st.project_name, NULLIF(st.assignee_name, ''), st.url, CONCAT('issue:', st.id), st.last_activity
  FROM stalled st
  WHERE st.days_in_progress > st.threshold_days
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Not closing', 6, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('In ', ms.sprints, ' sprints without closing'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ms.first_start, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN multi_sprint ms ON ms.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 'Critical' WHEN 'High' THEN 'High' WHEN 'Medium' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END,
    CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 1 WHEN 'High' THEN 2 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
    'Open bug', 7, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(oi.priority, ''), 'Unprioritised'), ' bug open ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE (oi.type = 'BUG' OR (oi.id LIKE 'github:%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels il WHERE il.issue_id = oi.id AND il.label_name IN ('bug','Production-Bug'))))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Unassigned in Ready', 8, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd, no assignee'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULL, oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND (oi.original_status IN ('Selected for Development', 'Dev Ready', 'Ready for Dev', 'Ready for Development') OR (oi.original_status IN ('To do', 'To Do', 'Todo') AND oi.id IN (SELECT si_r.issue_id FROM sprint_issues si_r JOIN sprints sp_r ON sp_r.id = si_r.sprint_id WHERE sp_r.status = 'ACTIVE'))) AND COALESCE(oi.assignee_id, '') = ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Critical', 1, 'Failed deploy', 9, CONCAT(ld.env, ' · ', LEFT(ld.sha, 7)), CONCAT(cs.name, ' · ', ld.env),
    CONCAT('Latest prod deployment failed ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), 'd ago, no success since'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), pc.project_name, NULL, ld.url, CONCAT('deploy:', ld.scope_id, ':', ld.env), ld.ts
  FROM latest_deploy ld
  JOIN project_cicd pc ON pc.scope_id = ld.scope_id
  JOIN cicd_scopes cs ON cs.id = ld.scope_id
  WHERE ld.rn = 1 AND ld.failed = 1 
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Scope added', 10, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('Added to the active sprint ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), 'd ago'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN scope_added sa ON sa.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
),
attention AS (
  SELECT severity, severity_rank, category, item, title, reason, age_days, project_name, owner, url, last_activity
  FROM (
    SELECT ar.severity, ar.severity_rank, ar.category, ar.item, ar.title, ar.reason, ar.age_days, ar.project_name, ar.owner, ar.url, ar.last_activity,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.project_name, ar.ref ORDER BY ar.severity_rank, ar.cat_rank) AS pick
    FROM att_raw ar
    WHERE ar.category IN ($category)
  ) ranked_items
  WHERE pick = 1
)
SELECT severity AS Severity, category AS Category, item AS Item, title AS Title, reason AS "Why it is here",
  age_days AS "Age (d)", last_activity AS "Last activity", project_name AS Team, owner AS Owner, url AS url
FROM attention
WHERE severity IN ($severity)
ORDER BY severity_rank, age_days DESC, item, project_name
